domain.name: Radiation-Induced DNA Damage and Repair
domain.description: Entities and relationships describing how low-dose ionising radiation damages DNA and the cellular mechanisms that detect, signal, and repair that damage.
domain.guiding_question: What DNA damage does low-dose radiation cause and how do cells repair it?

entity_types.name: DNA_LESION
entity_types.description: Type of DNA damage (DSB, SSB, base oxidation, clustered damage)

entity_types.name: REPAIR_PATHWAY
entity_types.description: DNA repair mechanism (NHEJ, HR, BER, MMR)

entity_types.name: REPAIR_PROTEIN
entity_types.description: Protein involved in damage recognition or repair

entity_types.name: DOSE_RATE
entity_types.description: Rate at which dose is delivered (acute vs chronic)

entity_types.name: CELL_TYPE
entity_types.description: Cell or tissue type in which damage occurs

relationship_types.name: CAUSES
relationship_types.description: Radiation causes a DNA lesion type

relationship_types.name: REPAIRED_BY
relationship_types.description: A lesion is repaired by a pathway

relationship_types.name: REQUIRES
relationship_types.description: A repair pathway requires a specific protein

relationship_types.name: MODULATES
relationship_types.description: Dose rate modulates repair fidelity or pathway choice

queries: low dose radiation DNA double strand break repair NHEJ HR site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
ionising radiation DNA damage response checkpoint ATM site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov

in_scope: DNA_LESION: Type of DNA damage (DSB, SSB, base oxidation, clustered damage)
REPAIR_PATHWAY: DNA repair mechanism (NHEJ, HR, BER, MMR)
REPAIR_PROTEIN: Protein involved in damage recognition or repair
DOSE_RATE: Rate at which dose is delivered (acute vs chronic)
CELL_TYPE: Cell or tissue type in which damage occurs
FIDELITY: Accuracy of repair (error-free vs error-prone)
out_of_scope: Epidemiological population-level cancer statistics unrelated to radiation

notes: Approximate metadata — original schema YAMLs not retained in repo.
